long_biography.plain_text:
Lionel Viret learned Stago from the inside, working in shipping and handling during university summers before joining the family diagnostics business. After succeeding his father as president, he reorganized departments built for a much smaller company and strengthened a common operating culture as Stago expanded internationally.

Innovation became central to his approach. The group invested in research, cultivated relationships with pharmaceutical companies, universities and start-ups, and invited ideas from across its workforce. Its integrated model covers the development and manufacture of analysers and reagents for haemostasis and thrombosis testing, giving laboratories a specialised platform for investigating blood-clotting disorders.

uncertainties: Mandatory Forbes-first searches found no dedicated Forbes profile or reliable Forbes article for Lionel Didier Pierre Viret, Lionel Viret or the Stago family owner-president.

The full legal name, birth date, nationality, residence and Stago roles resolve identity without relying on the yacht. The public vessel chain is supportive but incomplete: a 2019 register links EOLE SAS to Sharlou, while a later Swiss EOLE Sàrl led by Lionel Viret has the purpose of operating a sea-going pleasure yacht. No public filing directly states that the two EOLE entities or the later yacht are identical.

Filed French statutes establish Boulogne-Billancourt as Viret's birthplace. This conflicts with the immutable birth-country selection of Switzerland. The dossier proposes only the missing place_of_birth field and flags the existing birth-country value for human review; it does not edit or propose an unrequested overwrite of the immutable record.

Adelphi University states that Viret's father founded Stago and that Lionel took over the presidency in 2007; Stago names Jacques Viret as the founder, and 2025 filings show Lionel as sole shareholder. The private legal mechanics and timing of the family transfer are not published, so the evidence supports an active operator relationship but not a specific wealth-origin mechanism.

Stago and La Caisse announced transfer of the company from the founding Viret family to ARCHIMED and La Caisse in April 2026. The consideration, any retained seller interest and Viret's post-transaction investment structure are undisclosed. Current primary industry therefore remains Unknown rather than assuming Healthcare or Finance & Investments.

The known-for proposal uses 'Longtime President' rather than a current-title claim because pre-transaction sources clearly establish the presidency but post-transaction governance material does not clearly state whether Viret retained any formal office.

No exact personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok or personal website met the identity threshold. A Grenoble-based Lionel Viret LinkedIn profile belongs to a different person associated with ELEGIA GROUPE.

Current and historical vessel details, charter status, transaction consideration, live employee counts, revenue, company valuation, wealth estimates, private family details, residence, politics, legal disputes and lifestyle speculation are excluded from the biographies.
